content: Bitata̱mes wouds silma̱nin Yowbad

Aguyeimiy sigwey, peinan Yowbad ikalin nuwan ya̱kids; kadiloka bukuta̱mes woumiy mamagina lun bulukwan, kadilok Yowbad nawotet. E, kululuwamiy waseg kutams Yowbad nawotet waseg, peinan tut towen mwamovamiy son kusesus.
Awoum kulatanes son ven watinow sinapun; tage beivag ninoumiy kweivaw va̱gan bikatilow amisinap, mo bukukwakins Yowbad nanon, aveiyag kamnat, aveiyag bwein, o aveiyag bikalin nuwan waseg.
Yey agusinap nisiwyoubug, mapuna adibakeimiy tababaw yakamiy; “Awoum bukwaypamwes sinap, tage ninoumiy bidumwal ma̱wana Yowbad nilabeimiy, o nukusimounids, katanok katanok yakamiy.”
Taninuways woun wuliyougwan babaw siwotet kweitan kweitan.
Ma̱wan ya̱kids, babaw gamag ya̱kids, tage Kelis waseg nitamlavags katanoka woun o tananok tatanok ya̱kids talabeids sidsidayas.

Yowbad nasiwa̱youb waseg yey kweitan, waseg yak kweitan, wasigeis sidayas kweitan kweitan; kadiloka bitawotets ma̱wan. Kukin Yowbad bisiwyoub kavel va̱gan bikakin anilivan bilivnek; e, kadiloka bisimounid waseg, mo bilivan ma̱wan.
Kukin kavel Yowbad bisek sinapun wotet, kadiloka biwtel ma̱wan. Kukin kavel Yowbad bisek katimlakay sinapun, kadiloka bikatimlakay ma̱wan.

Kukin kavel bisek geiguy sinapun, kadiloka bigeiguy ma̱wan. Kukin kavel bisek sinapun muloul, kadiloka bimuloul beibwein. Kukin kavel bisek nawotet va̱gan bilabes sidayas kadiloka biseiw nuwan towen silma̱nin. Kukin kavel bisek nawotet va̱gan binok nuwan sidayas, kadiloka bimwa̱saw waseg nawotet towen.
Kaleiwag silma̱nin tayakelesiys
Kadiloka kusiwa̱youbs mounid; sinap kalbaleb kulavewas, tage sinap bwanabwein kuyousis.
Bikalin nuwamiy, mo bukusiwyoubus simiyas. Kal singaya bivnas son? Kadiloka biseiw nuwamiy va̱gan bukuvna̱ses simiyas!
Kadiloka tuta babaw biseiw nuwamiy Yowbad nawotet. Yowbad Kululuwan biwekeimiy mo bukukwamnats. Kadiloka bukutoukums daGuyaws nawotet waseg.
Kumwa̱saws minamis waseg. Igaw gamag biyagageimiy bweina kwaptuleimiy. Kadiloka tut babaw bukuninitougs Yowbad waseg.
Kumulouls va̱gan bukulabes tasiyas tayakelesiys. Kutams tasiyas amibwabwal wasigeis.
Amilivan siwa̱youb kusekes tasiyas niyagageimiy; e, kusiwyoubus; awoum kubulates. Awoum.
Kumwa̱saws simiyas tasiyas tammwa̱saws. Kuva̱lams simiyas tasiyas tavva̱lams.
Kadiloka kumsamwas simsimiyas wasigeis. Awoum bukumliguyaws, kadiloka kutams tasiyas toul wasigeis. Awoum kukwaypamwes sinap. Awoum.
Tasiyas iyagageimiy awoum kuyagages tasiyas; tage beivag amisinap bwein wamtes gamag babaw.
Magat kadilokeimiy bukumsamwas simiyas meiveka gamag. Kadiloka kuyokons silma̱nin.
O kalin nuwag sigwey, awoum kwatimapus asisinap tasiyas niyagageimiy; bisiw; igaw Yowbad mo bikatimop. Liva̱nen nises mamagina:
DaGuyaws anilivan mamagin.
Awoum kwatimapus asisinap. Tage towen nikamliweim, igaw beivag anamoun, bweina kusek kan beikam. Kukin beivag anadak, bweina kukil soup kusek beimoum, mo beivag anmwasin.
Awoum sinap kalbaleb bitakayway wasigeis yakamiy, tage beibwein amisinap va̱gan bukutakayways waseg sinap kalbaleb.
